data.name: Zolly
data.gender_notes: Zolly is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hungarian name Zolán, meaning 'descendant of Solomon' or the Greek name Zoë, meaning 'life'. Zolly represents a bright, radiant, and joyful spirit. This name is perfect for a child who brings sunshine into the world. The name Zolly carries the meaning “Dazzling, Radiant, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Zolly usually hope their child will grow to embody dazzling, radiant, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Zolly is a name that embodies the light and joy of the divine. It is a reminder of the radiant spirit that resides within each of us, and a reminder to let that light shine bright in the world.
data.etymology: Zolly belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dazzling, Radiant, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zolly total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

While the Greek origin gives the name a connection to the ancient, philosophical, and spiritual traditions of the Mediterranean. This fusion of cultures provides a diverse and complex foundation for understanding the name and its meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Zolly" lies in its meaning derived from both the Hebrew (as in Solomon) and Greek roots. From a Hebrew perspective, the name Zolly reminds us of the wise and just King Solomon, a man of great wisdom and knowledge. From a Greek perspective, the name invokes the idea of life and living fully. These meanings come together to create a powerful symbol of a spiritually grounded, wise, and radiant individual who brings joy and life to the world.
